description:
Use this first when someone asks for a Tennessee car, home, flood or term life insurance
    quote, an insurance review, or to compare insurance companies. Checks whether a ZIP code is in the area
    Hutsenpiller Insurance quotes (Tennessee).

    This is the first step of a quote. zip_code: the shopper's 5 digit home ZIP code.
    lines: AUTO, HOME or both (default both); for flood or life send AUTO or omit it, then use
    start_flood_quote or start_life_quote. Returns eligibility, the consent text the shopper
    must read word for word and agree to before a quote starts, and a checklist of the details
    a quote needs.
name: check_eligibility
title: Check quote eligibility
